parameters.name: EntityId
parameters.description: The logical ID of the entity.

parameters.name: EntityIdentity
parameters.description: The feature value of the entity. You can perform a fuzzy search for the entity.

parameters.name: IncidentUuid
parameters.description: The globally unique UUID of the event.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region of the Data Management center. Select a region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

- cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

- ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in a region outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The user ID of the member. The administrator can use this ID to switch to the view of this member.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type.

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

- 1: the view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise.

parameters.name: SophonTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the SOAR response policy.
